// diagnostic

E0438

This pipe step doesn't use `<>`

What

This pipe step doesn't use `<>`

Why

Each `|>` step receives the value of the line above as `<>`; a step that never reads it drops that value

Fix

Write `<>` where the value goes, such as `|> f(<>)`, or end the pipe before this step

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0438: tests/ui/compiler_api/flow_pipe_shape_has_no_foreign_guess.stderr.

Error [jet.PipeStepWithoutValue]: This pipe step doesn't use `<>`
  --> tests/ui/compiler_api/flow_pipe_shape_has_no_foreign_guess.jet:2:14
    |
  2 |     value: 1 |> print
    |              ^^^^^^^^
 Why: Each `|>` step receives the value of the line above as `<>`; a step that never reads it drops that value
 Fix: Write `<>` where the value goes: `print(<>)`
